## Errors & unexpected behaviors
- Step 6.2: commit-distill failed 3 times due to nested worktree detection. Background ledger agents shifted the orchestrator's CWD to a stale worktree path (`agent-ae9447d2`), causing all subsequent `isolation: "worktree"` agent spawns to create worktrees-of-worktrees. Resolved by spawning a proxy agent (without isolation) that then spawned the commit-distill subagent from the correct CWD.
- Steps 8+: Orchestrator itself runs inside worktree `agent-a66c6a44`, causing all direct `isolation: "worktree"` agent spawns to nest. All groups from 8 onward use the proxy agent pattern.
- Steps 9.2, 10.2: Distill phases still in progress via background proxy agents at session checkpoint time. Group 10 proxy agent processing 33-commit distill (may have hit context limits).
